test_title: PYST 15: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 04 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with appropriate option. 

The first time that nuclear radiation has been washed off with a __________.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** blank requires** a word that denotes something done swiftly and effectively.
 
• **"Quick shower" **is the correct phrase, indicating a brief and efficient washing process.
 
• **It makes sense **in the context of washing off nuclear radiation.

Therefore, the** correct sentence** is: *"The first time that nuclear radiation has been washed off with a quick shower."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1**: "fast shower"** doesn't sound as natural as "quick shower" in English.
 
• Option 3:** "speedy shower"** is redundant as "speedy" and "shower" both indicate quickness.
 
• Option 4: **"energetic shower" **does not fit the context of the sentence.
